description: Inquiry findings describe alleged perpetrators harnessing their professional reputations and authority to manipulate other adults and operate undetected.

aspect: Elite sport compared to coercive control
description: Abuse dynamics in some sporting contexts have been compared to the coercive control seen in domestic abuse - coaches controlling diet, social activity and relationships, with athletes fearing disclosure would end their careers.
energy_note: Controlled totally, with a career as the hostage.

description: Ecological analysis of sport identifies excessive parental trust in coaches as itself a risk factor, alongside inadequate supervision and poor club responses.

aspect: Survivor accounts are mostly not the famous cases
description: Truth Project work found that unlike the elite cases that attract coverage, survivor accounts reflected far more grassroots contexts - ordinary clubs, ordinary weeks.
energy_note: Not the famous ones. The Saturday morning ones.
